Liquidity is adequate but not strong (current ratio 1.32), which suggests some near-term working-capital sensitivity. Leverage appears moderate (total liabilities are well below total assets) and profitability is solid relative to revenue (EBIT/operating income of 2,702M on 14,969M revenue), supporting good debt-servicing capacity. Overall, the balance sheet strength and operating performance point to an upper-investment-grade profile.

DECISION: A-
